versions.subject: feat: update cmd based rules
versions.detection:
selection_img:
    - Image|endswith: '\wmic.exe'
    - OriginalFileName: 'wmic.exe'
selection_cli:
    CommandLine|contains:
        - 'AntiVirusProduct'
        - 'FirewallProduct'
condition: all of selection_*
